analysis.headline: Shares Your Data Broadly
analysis.quote: We will also disclose your information to third parties: ... to provide you, or permit selected third parties to provide you, with information about goods or services we feel may interest you in accordance with your consent and our Privacy notices.

analysis.headline: Shares with Group Companies
analysis.quote: You agree that we have the right to share your information with any member of our group, which means our subsidiaries, our ultimate holding company and its subsidiaries, as defined in section 1159 and as listed here.

analysis.headline: Shares with Business Partners
analysis.quote: We are working closely with third parties (including, for example, business partners, sub-contractors in technical, payment and delivery services, advertising networks, analytics providers, search information providers, credit reference agencies).

analysis.headline: Tracks You Across Sites
analysis.quote: The Facebook pixel allows us to see how many people take action on our ads and which ad led to a conversion. Website events are shared with the Facebook Conversions API.

analysis.headline: Collects Detailed Activity Data
analysis.quote: Information about your visit. This information includes the full Uniform Resource Locators (URL), clickstream to, through and from our site (including date and time, timezone, your geolocation), items you viewed or searched for, page response times, download errors, length of visits to certain pages, page interaction information (such as scrolling, clicks, and mouse-overs), methods used to browse away from the page.

analysis.headline: Receives Data from Others
analysis.quote: Information we receive from other sources. This is information we receive about you if you use any of the other websites we operate or the other services we provide.

analysis.headline: Records Your Phone Calls
analysis.quote: When you correspond with us by phone, calls may be recorded for training and monitoring purposes. Canonical may also use third party providers for such services.

analysis.headline: Your Posts May Go Public
analysis.quote: Any information that you disclose in these areas [Chat rooms, forums and newsgroups] becomes public information and may be recorded, archived and republished by anyone.

analysis.headline: Your Data Stored Internationally
analysis.quote: The information that we collect from you will be transferred to, and stored at, a destination outside the European Economic Area ("EEA").
